title: Approval Git boundary: metadata_line trims Unicode whitespace from Git metadata paths
outcome: The approval boundary's Git validation (delegation_git_boundary::is_valid via metadata_line) reads a `.git` gitdir line, commondir and backpointer exactly as Git wrote them, removing only the line ending, so a worktree path ending in Unicode whitespace validates its own administrative directory and never a sibling's.
acceptance: Approval Git boundary: metadata_line trims Unicode whitespace from Git metadata paths is done
